prompt.alinti: Anthropic just released their official Clawed Code prompt library and it's completely free.
These aren't just some random prompts, these are the exact four rules Anthropic's own engineers use when working with Clawed Code.
First, you need to teach Claude reusable skills with slash commands instead of reprompting it every single time.
Second, you want to hit shift plus tab to activate plan mode and it maps out your entire project before writing a single line of code.
Third, drop a claude.md file into your project and it automatically learns your naming conventions, libraries and rules every single session.
And here's the thing, there's already over 100 free templates you can copy right now inside of this resource.
So if you want full access, just comment claude and I will send it over.
